subject: Implementation compact: sprint play & acceptance pledge
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Sandy Cortez <sandy.cortez@helixai.com>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation compact: sprint play & acceptance pledge

Hi Sandy / Diego,

As discussed in yesterday's kickoff, attached is a concise "implementation compact" (spreadsheet + one‑page) that pairs milestones with owners, acceptance criteria, and earliest target dates. Goal: provide a single page the execs can read and the delivery team can run against.

High level asks from HelixAI so we can lock dates:
- Confirm prioritized scope for Phase 1 (Realtime embeddings + search rerank) by EOD 9/4
- Assign a single Helix owner for integration testing (name + calendar availability)
- Confirm procurement milestone (PO or signature) target week

What I attached: redwood-implementation-compact-v1.xlsx (tabs: summary, milestones, owners, risks) and a SOW draft for internal review.

Proposed immediate milestones (short list):
1) Infra provisioning (Redwood Dedicated pool) — owner: Ben Carter — target: 9/10 — acceptance: GPU pool up + smoke test < 150ms p50
2) Integration sprint 0 — owner: Helix (Sandy) + Redwood SE (Marissa) — target: 9/20 — acceptance: end-to-end demo with sample queries
3) Data onboarding & privacy sign-off — owner: Helix Security (Diego) — target: 9/17 — acceptance: signed evidence & vault config

I'll leave Marissa to propose the detailed sprint lanes and a lightweight weekly cadence (15m sync + ops triage). Please reply with confirmations or redlines.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-implementation-compact-v1.xlsx; SOW-HelixAI-draft-v2.pdf
From: Sandy Cortez <sandy.cortez@helixai.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation compact: sprint play & acceptance pledge

Thanks Nikhil — this is helpful and concise. Quick answers: 
- Phase 1 scope confirmed for Realtime embeddings + search rerank (no custom policies in phase 1).
- I’ll be the Helix owner for Integration testing; availability windows next week: 9/7–9/9 mornings (PDT).
- Procurement: PO in process; procurement team aiming for signature week of 9/13. Diego, can you confirm the evidence items for privacy sign-off?

Two small asks from our side: 
1) Can you move the provisioning milestone earlier if possible? We have a customer demo on 9/24 and need at least a two‑week buffer.
2) Can we add a short fallback acceptance (what to do if p50 latency > 150ms)?

- Sandy
Director, Product
HelixAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation compact: sprint play & acceptance pledge

Thanks Sandy — noted. A few adjustments from our delivery side: 
- Ben, can you confirm if we can target provisioning for 9/8 instead of 9/10 (two-day acceleration)? If GPU inventory permits, we should prioritize.
- I'll own the integration lane with Sandy; propose the following cadence: weekly 15m cross-team sync (Tuesdays 9am PT), ops triage (Thursdays 30m) and a biweekly technical review for open blockers.
- Fallback plan (Sandy's ask): add an acceptance flag and rollback trigger — if p50 > 200ms after tuning pass, Redwood will: 1) enable smaller batch sizes for the demo window, 2) temporarily pin quantized variant with throughput SLA, 3) escalate to an SE-led optimization sprint.

I updated the milestones tab and added a 'fallthrough' column in the spreadsheet. Attaching the spreadsheet with inline notes (version v1.1). 

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

1) Provisioning estimate and earliest slot we can reserve for Helix (Ben)
2) A named QA contact and runbook owner for the cutover smoke tests (Monica)

We should assume the Helix demo window on 9/24 is fixed and plan backwards. If provisioning is not available before 9/10, call it out and propose mitigations (demo on staging or co-hosted fallback).
